title: Krrsantan
description: The Wookiee Krrsantan made a name for himself in the criminal underworld with his intimidating presence and unstoppable raw strength. He worked for clients ranging from Jabba the Hutt and Darth Vader to Dr. Aphra and Jabba's cousins, the Twins. After being captured by Boba Fett and given his freedom once more, Krrsantan found himself side-by-side with Boba Fett defending Mos Espa.
